description: This file defines a custom guardrail class 'AporiaGuardrail' for integrating AporiaAI with a language model system, including methods for message transformation, API request preparation, and moderation hooks.

classes.name: AporiaGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class for integrating AporiaAI with a language model system, providing message transformation, API request handling, and moderation hooks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AporiaGuardrail with optional API key and base URL, setting up the HTTP client and environment variables.

methods.name: transform_messages
methods.description: Transforms message list to ensure roles are supported; unsupported roles are replaced with 'other'.

methods.name: prepare_aporia_request
methods.description: Prepares the request payload for AporiaAI API, including messages and response, and sets validation target.

methods.name: make_aporia_api_request
methods.description: Sends a POST request to AporiaAI API with prepared data and handles response, raising exception if blocked.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to send moderation data to AporiaAI after a successful API call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Moderation hook to evaluate messages during a call and send data to AporiaAI for moderation.
